title: EMIR Reporting Readiness Diagnostic
description: Grade a firm's EMIR Refit reporting readiness across five dimensions: ISO 20022 format cutover, UPI sourcing via ANNA DSB, UTI sharing SLA (10:00 CET T+1), reconciliation tolerance configuration (148-field set, 2026 escalation), and lifecycle action-type controls. Returns an A–F grade and a gap list identifying failing dimensions. Zero network, zero PII.
